verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a static reference section (e.g. the BrowserClipboard page), a quickstart, and copy-paste snippets for coding assistants. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or examples that run in the browser. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec behind a try-it console either. Static reference pages are an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.
